The differential test at cml_laws.rs:397-419 proves only nonempty and disjoint codes. It is not syntax-table completeness evidence.

Monitoring: treat const-evaluation failures, law-c failures, or new cml.elab.unsupported code collisions as release blockers. Retain typed-refusal metrics if this path reaches production.

Validation: static review covered every changed file, production refusal constructors, and error-code routing. No tests ran under this metadata-only reviewer contract. No range-introduced security blocker remains. This LGTM does not satisfy the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.
